name: Sabé's shuttle
description: Sabé's shuttle was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle of the Galactic Empire. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Commander Sabé utilized the shuttle to rescue the Sith Lord Darth Vader, who had lost control of his Force powers due to a Force Wave and breached the hull of his flagship, the Executor. However, Vader's erratic Force powers continued once he was brought on board, damaging the shuttle as Sabé traveled to an astronomical object where sentient life was not at risk. Vader was thrown out as the shuttle fell through the atmosphere, with Sabé jumping out to rescue him before the ship crashed into the ocean.

data.name: Sabé's shuttle
